seo.title: German A2 Course in Dehradun | Goethe-Zertifikat A2 | Language Zone
seo.description: German A2 (Elementary) course in Dehradun. Describe your routine, the past and simple plans. Online and offline batches at Language Zone.

tagline: Talk about your routine and your past
outcomes: Talk about work, family, shopping and free time in simple sentences
Describe past events using the Perfekt
Understand short, clear messages and announcements
Write short personal messages and invitations
Manage simple situations when travelling or visiting the doctor
suits: Applicants whose application or course asks for A2
Anyone who wants to speak with more confidence in daily situations
syllabus: Subordinate clauses with weil and dass

skills.reading: Short texts such as emails, ads and schedules
skills.writing: Write short personal messages and notes

faq.q: Can I join A2 without taking A1 here?
faq.a: Yes, after a short level check with a trainer. If you are unsure, we place you in the batch that fits.

faq.q: Is the Perfekt really that hard?
faq.a: It becomes easy with practice. We drill the common verbs in speaking tasks until the pattern feels natural.

faq.q: Which exam do I take after this course?
faq.a: The Goethe-Zertifikat A2, when you are ready. We guide you through registration.
